author: Vieillot, 1819

months.note: 알려진 국내 기록은 모두 9월이며, 국내에서 기록된 달이다.

summary: 우리나라에서는 미조로 기록된 도요로, 풀밭과 내륙의 물가에서 지낸다. 알래스카 극지방과 북극 툰드라, 캐나다 북서부에서 번식하며 한배에 갈색 반점이 있는 알 4개를 낳는다. 겨울은 아르헨티나에서 난다.

points.en: blackish-brown upperparts with white feather tips

sexes.text: 암수 생김새가 같고 수컷이 조금 더 크다.

young: 어린새는 등과 어깨깃의 검은 갈색 깃에 크림색~흰색 가장자리가 깔끔하게 둘려 비늘무늬가 뚜렷하고, 담황색 가슴 양옆에 검은 점이 있다.

similar.how: 누른도요는 목도리도요 어린새와 색이 비슷하지만 더 작고 부리가 짧고 가늘며, 무늬 없는 밝은 얼굴에 검은 눈이 두드러진다.

art.subject: Buff-breasted Sandpiper (Calidris subruficollis), juvenile in its first autumn, as a vagrant in September: crown buff with fine dark streaks; face plain warm buff with a large dark eye set in a thin whitish eye-ring; neck and breast warm buff, the breast sides marked with small dark spots; mantle, scapulars, tertials and wing coverts blackish-brown with neat pale buff-white fringes, giving a crisp scaly pattern; belly buff, fading to whitish on the vent. Bill short, thin, straight and black. Legs bright ochre-yellow.
art.pose: walking in short grass, side view
art.scene: Short-grass field beside an inland pond in Korea in September, autumn migration, warm low light; no people, buildings or text
views: juvenile (autumn), side view standing upright in short grass: plain buff face, short straight black bill, blackish-brown upperparts neatly scaled with pale buff-white feather tips, buff breast with small dark spots on the sides, buff belly, bright yellow legs
juvenile, head detail in side view: plain buff face, large dark eye in a thin pale eye-ring, finely streaked buff crown, short, thin, straight black bill
art.build: Slim, small-headed sandpiper, 20cm, clearly larger than a sparrow and about the size of a Dunlin but longer-necked; round dove-like head and upright, plover-like stance, walking with high steps through short grass. Bill black, shorter than the head, thin and straight. Legs medium length, bright yellow. At rest the wingtips reach about the tail tip. In flight the upperwing is plain with no white wing-bar, the rump and tail are dark without white sides, and the white underwing shows a dark crescent across the primary coverts.
avoid: Do not paint a long or drooping bill; the bill is short, thin and shorter than the head.
Do not give it a white wing-bar or white oval patches at the sides of the tail base; those mark Ruff (Calidris pugnax).
Do not paint a streaked breast band ending sharply on a white belly (Pectoral Sandpiper); this bird is buff from face to belly.
Do not paint grey, greenish or black legs.
